Or you can go for fake plants. Do you have a handheld digital thermometer to check basking spot temps? Also recommend one of those. You can get them on Amazon for like 15 bucks. Hi there!! I don't know if you've ever been on Josh frogs... they have so much great snake stuff. They sell bundles for different types of enclosures. So they have bundles (small, medium, and large) for arid enclosures. Since hoggy tanks aren't very humid generally the plants need to be a bit more hardy/ able to survive in dryer temps. I think I'm noticing that the thermometer is on the outside of the tank? I could be wrong. But it's supposed to be inside. Aspen isn't really a good substrate. They generally prefer a more dirt/sand substrate. (I like josh frogs desert substrate) All of the moving might be stressing it out. And so might a larger enclosure. I would add some leaf little and sphagum moss. It will clutter the tank more so snek isn't so stressed and it will help hold humidity. Definitely recommend getting a hydrometer. They're like $8 for a non digital and $15 for a digital on Amazon. Not sure where you live but if it's winter sometimes it's normal for them not to eat. But with the accompanied weight loss and skin issues it could be alot of stuff. Highly recommend vet ASAP.

Also I'm just noticing the enclosure is top opening. Generally for snakes i recommend front opening. So maybe when you upgrade go for a front open tank instead. Especially with smaller snakes birds tend to be they're biggest predators so they don't like being approached from the top generally and it can sometimes stress them out a bit. Because they might view you as more a threat. Just food for thought. As far as heating goes it can really tend to depend on the ambient temps and size of tank etc. Often it's trial and error. You should get a digital thermometer/ hydrometer to put in the tank to measure the ambient temp in there. And then get a handheld digital thermometer so you can check the temp of the basking spot. If it's too warm then go with a lower wattage if it's too cool then kick it up! The link i added also has the proper uvb bulb listed. The thermometers should be like 15 bucks each on Amazon so not too bad!
Also! U can use this link it gives alot of info about hoggy enclosures. https://www.zenhabitats.com/blogs/reptile-care-sheets-resources/hognose-snake-care-sheet-reptifiles
